svg.title: CMD & CTRL
svg.desc: Source of truth for the rounded app icon. The mark is the one in src/lib/components/Wordmark.svelte (its 64-unit geometry times 8): an upright card with a second card turned sideways, tapped, cut out of it. Drawn in the default skin, War room: the upright card in its text colour (#e8eff7) and the tapped one in its accent (#ff7a1a), on its ink (#070d14). Regenerate the PNGs with client/tools/gen-icons.sh after editing.
